sloka: नाहं स्वप्नमिमं मन्ये स्वप्ने दृष्ट्वा हि वानरम् ।न शक्यो ऽभ्युदयः प्राप्तुं प्राप्तश्चाभ्युदयो मम ।। ५.३४.२२।।।।
transliteration: nāhaṁ svapnamimaṁ manye svapne dṛṣṭvā hi vānaram ।na śakyo 'bhyudayaḥ prāptuṁ prāptaścābhyudayo mama ।। 5.34.22।।।।

translations.english: "I do not think it is a dream. Pleasure cannot be experienced by seeing a vanara in a dream. I experience pleasure now (seeing a monkey in a dream is a bad omen).
translations.hindi: । भला कोसल्या, सुमित्रा और भरतजी का कुशलसंवाद तो जब कभी उनको, मिलता रहता है न?
